title: gspot.toml
description: The policy of one repository under gspot: configurations, scopes, limits, naming, tools, ignores, declarations and hooks.

level.description: Recommended runs defect checks. All also runs style and layout checks.

require_reasons.description: Require a reason for ignores and loosened settings.

extra_checks.description: Checks at level all to run individually at level recommended.

exclude.description: Paths and directory patterns excluded before reading source content.

generated.description: Generated files excluded from source checks.

vendored.description: Upstream files excluded from source checks.

inputs.description: Root-relative file globs read by the command, including ignored files. Omit to disable caching.

findings_exit_codes.description: Native nonzero statuses that mean source findings. Other nonzero statuses mean execution failure.

fix_findings_exit_codes.description: Native nonzero correction exit codes that mean findings remain. Other nonzero codes are execution errors.

tool_errors.description: A multiline Unicode regular expression matching fatal tool diagnostics in stdout or stderr, for both checks and corrections.

tool.description: The tool that owns repository hooks.

push.description: Check affected paths or the full tree of each pushed revision.

provider.description: The CI provider that receives generated jobs.

platforms.description: Platforms for GitHub check and manual jobs.

run.description: Check changed inputs or the full checked-out tree in CI.

sarif.description: Upload SARIF through a separate GitHub code-scanning job.

install.description: Install rule files and agent instructions.

project.description: Repository-relative project rule layer linked from agent instructions.

exclude.description: Rule file patterns excluded from the installed selection.

agents.description: Additional repository-relative agent instruction files; AGENTS.md and detected supported files are included automatically.

tool.description: The runner that receives generated tasks.

tasks.description: Accepted names for generated check, fix, apply, and doctor tasks.
